The pathological assessment of distant metastasis entails microscopic examination.

implementation.markdown: Single tumor cells or small cluster of tumor cells, not larger than 0.2 mm in diameter, usually detected by immunohistochemistry or molecular pathology. No typical characteristics of metastases (stromal reaction, proliferation). If such ITC are detected in lymph nodes, those are classified as pN0(i+) or pN0(mol+) (regional) or as pM0(i+) or pM0(mol+) (non-regional). For negativity of immunohistochemical or molecular pathologic findings in lymph nodes the same rules are applied (i- or mol-)

implementation.markdown: Method of histopathology to describe semiquantitatively resp. to classify the grade of differentiation / grade of malignancy of a malignant tumor.
